cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.14)
project(test_project)

include(ExternalProject)

# Test ExternalProject_Add with Git repository
ExternalProject_Add(
  googletest
  GIT_REPOSITORY https://github.com/google/googletest.git
  GIT_TAG        release-1.12.1
  CMAKE_ARGS     -DCMAKE_INSTALL_PREFIX=${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}/install
)

# Test ExternalProject_Add with URL and hash
ExternalProject_Add(
  zlib
  URL https://zlib.net/zlib-1.2.13.tar.gz
  URL_HASH SHA256=b3a24de97a8fdbc835b9833169501030b8977031bcb54b3b3ac13740f846ab30
)

# Test ExternalProject_Add with Bitbucket
ExternalProject_Add(
  eigen
  GIT_REPOSITORY https://bitbucket.org/eigen/eigen.git
  GIT_TAG        3.4.0
)
